turns.text: To begin with, we confirm the trigger, purpose, model, and terms. That is done by: Preparer; advisers resolve gaps. Before starting we need trigger, current governing documents, approved model. What we do: identify the structure and calculation layer; record every applicable term and definition; confirm the version-controlled model and as-of date Output and record to keep: Locked calculation instructions.
What event prompts the preparer to begin confirming the trigger, terms, and model?

Next, we collect and reconcile cumulative inputs. That is done by: Preparer. Before starting we need accounting, transaction, valuation, prior-model data. What we do: collect cumulative inputs; match opening balances, prior carried interest, holdback, and clawback to the GL and prior approved model Output and record to keep: Reconciled input package.
